_comment: What real people said, not what we would write for them. Every case is somebody's own words from a forum post, a news quote or an incident report, with the link it came from. 'provenance' says how close it is: 'verbatim' is their sentence as written (spelling and grammar kept); 'joined' puts two of their sentences that sat next to each other into one turn; 'title and post' adds the thread's title in front, because the post only makes sense under it; 'first person' is a report written about somebody (an incident report, a company statement) put back into the words they would say, with their nouns kept. Words of ours added to make a turn are named in that case's note; nothing else is invented. Collected 22 October 2026. Run with: npm run eval -- --file evals/real-voices.json (a model run, so it costs money). test-real-voices.mjs checks the file for free. Not found in public and so not here yet: HF radio operators (the RadioReference threads refused every fetch), satellite operators, crewed spaceflight, airlines and private pilots asking in their own words, data centres, pipelines, drilling, rail, mining, fleets, magnetic survey and delivery robots. Reddit was not reachable. Those roles stay covered only by golden.json, which is our wording.

cases.say: Our dealer says the storm has affected all brands of GPS, not solely John Deere. Should we shut off RTK?

cases.note: The dealer's sentence is verbatim. "Should we shut off RTK?" is ours: it is the dealer's advice to its customers (shut off RTK, use the SF2 or SF3 grace period) turned into the question a customer would ask.

cases.say: My main question is when there are solar storms, or bad ionospheric conditions, does your GPS residuals still read as being good or will they actually give you bad readings or not be able to connect at all, so that you would know right away.

cases.say: I set up on it and backsighted and my residuals were about 0.6' both vertical and horizontal. I then noticed that there were high Ionospheric condition this morning in the NWWA region.

cases.note: The report: 'the DPOs regularly experienced unstable DGNSS differential signals between the hours of 18:30hrs and 22:45hrs.' Evening scintillation, the plasma bubble hours.
